quests.instruction: Tortillas and arepas are staples in many countries of the Americas. Which grain are they made from?
quests.hint: It grows on a cob.
quests.explanation: Both are made from ground corn, which has been a staple food in the Americas for thousands of years. Rice and oats are not used for them.
quests.funFact: Corn was first grown thousands of years ago in what is now Mexico.

quests.instruction: Which grain-like seed from the Andes mountains of South America is cooked like rice?
quests.hint: Its tiny seeds curl as they cook.
quests.explanation: Quinoa is a seed grown in the Andes that people cook like a grain. A tortilla and a bagel are baked breads.
quests.funFact: Quinoa has been grown in the Andes for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: Which starchy root is a staple food in parts of Africa, Asia and South America and must be cooked before it is eaten?
quests.hint: It grows underground and is also used to make tapioca.
quests.explanation: Cassava is a root crop that many families rely on. Kiwi is a fruit and lettuce is a leaf.
quests.funFact: Cassava can grow in poor soil and in dry weather, which helps feed many families.

quests.instruction: Which spongy, slightly sour flatbread from Ethiopia is used to scoop up stews?
quests.hint: It is torn into pieces and used instead of a spoon.
quests.explanation: Injera is a soft flatbread that is also the plate and the spoon at many Ethiopian meals. A baguette and a bagel are baked differently.
quests.funFact: Injera is made from teff, a tiny grain grown in Ethiopia.

quests.instruction: Which tiny steamed granules of wheat are served with stews in Morocco and other North African countries?
quests.hint: They look like very small grains but are made from wheat.
quests.explanation: Couscous is made from tiny pieces of wheat that are steamed. Popcorn is corn and ramen is a noodle soup.
quests.funFact: Couscous is traditionally made by rolling tiny balls of wheat by hand and steaming them.

quests.instruction: Which round corn cake from Colombia and Venezuela is split open and filled with cheese, beans or meat?
quests.hint: It is made from cornmeal.
quests.explanation: An arepa is a corn cake that can be filled like a sandwich. A muffin and a croissant are baked from wheat, not corn.
quests.funFact: Arepas can be grilled, baked or fried.

quests.instruction: Which Vietnamese soup of rice noodles in broth is served with fresh herbs and lime?
quests.hint: It is eaten with chopsticks and a spoon.
quests.explanation: Pho is a noodle soup from Vietnam. Lasagna is baked pasta and paella is a rice dish.
quests.funFact: Pho is often eaten for breakfast in Vietnam.

quests.instruction: Which spicy fermented cabbage is a side dish at almost every Korean meal?
quests.hint: It tastes sour and crunchy.
quests.explanation: Kimchi is vegetables fermented with spices. Salsa and guacamole are fresh dips from Latin America.
quests.funFact: Kimchi can be made from many vegetables, not only cabbage.

quests.instruction: Which Japanese soup, made from fermented soybean paste, often comes with a meal?
quests.hint: It is served warm in a small bowl.
quests.explanation: Miso soup is a warm broth flavored with soybean paste. Ice cream and pancakes are not soups.
quests.funFact: Miso is made by fermenting soybeans with salt and a special mold.

quests.instruction: Which pastry pocket, filled with meat, cheese or vegetables and baked or fried, is popular in Spain and across Latin America?
quests.hint: It is folded over like a half-moon.
quests.explanation: An empanada is a folded pastry with a savory filling. Cupcakes and waffles are sweet.
quests.funFact: The name empanada comes from a Spanish word meaning to wrap in bread.

quests.instruction: Which Mexican food is corn dough with a filling, steamed inside a corn husk?
quests.hint: The husk is a wrapper and is not eaten.
quests.explanation: A tamale is steamed in its own wrapper. A taco is folded and a burrito is wrapped in a tortilla.
quests.funFact: Tamales are often made in big batches for family celebrations.

quests.instruction: Which triangular fried pastry, often filled with spiced potatoes and peas, is popular in South Asia?
quests.hint: It has a crisp shell and a soft filling.
quests.explanation: A samosa is a fried pastry with a spiced filling. A muffin and a bagel are baked, and neither has a spiced filling.
quests.funFact: Samosas are enjoyed in many countries, and the filling changes from place to place.

quests.instruction: Which fragrant rice dish, layered with spices and vegetables or meat, is popular in South Asia?
quests.hint: Rice and spices cook together.
quests.explanation: Biryani is rice cooked with spices. Sushi uses cold seasoned rice and pancakes are not made from rice.
quests.funFact: Biryani is often served at celebrations and family gatherings.

quests.instruction: Which thin, crispy pancake made from fermented rice and lentil batter is a favorite in South India?
quests.hint: The batter rests overnight before cooking.
quests.explanation: A dosa is made from a fermented batter of rice and lentils. A waffle and a muffin are made from wheat batter.
quests.funFact: Dosa batter is left to ferment overnight, a bit like the dough for some breads.

quests.instruction: Which round flatbread, cooked on a flat pan without yeast, is an everyday bread in many Indian homes?
quests.hint: It is soft and thin, and it scoops up curry.
quests.explanation: Roti is a quick flatbread cooked on a hot pan. A croissant and a bagel are made with yeast.
quests.funFact: Roti dough needs only whole-wheat flour and water.

quests.instruction: Which Thai dish is rice noodles stir-fried with egg, peanuts and a squeeze of lime?
quests.hint: It mixes sweet, sour and salty tastes.
quests.explanation: Pad thai is a stir-fried noodle dish from Thailand. Pierogi are filled dumplings and lasagna is baked pasta.
quests.funFact: Pad thai balances sweet, sour, salty and spicy flavors.

quests.instruction: Which style of Chinese meal is made of many small steamed or fried dishes, shared at the table with tea?
quests.hint: Small baskets arrive one after another.
quests.explanation: Dim sum is a meal of small shared dishes. Hamburgers and waffles are not served that way.
quests.funFact: In Cantonese, going for dim sum is often called drinking tea.

quests.instruction: Which shared meal is cooked at the table in a pot of bubbling broth, with grown-ups handling the heat?
quests.hint: Everyone cooks their own slices of food.
quests.explanation: A hot pot is a simmering pot in the middle of the table where food is cooked as people eat. A picnic and a salad bar are not cooked at the table.
quests.funFact: Hot pot is popular across Asia, and each place has its own broths and ingredients.

quests.instruction: Which flat round dish, first made in Naples, Italy, is topped with tomato and cheese?
quests.hint: It is baked in a very hot oven.
quests.explanation: Pizza began in Naples as a cheap, quick meal. Pierogi come from Poland and tacos from Mexico.
quests.funFact: Pizza began as an inexpensive, quick meal for workers in Naples.

quests.instruction: Which British takeaway meal is fried fish with thick potato fries?
quests.hint: It is often wrapped in paper.
quests.explanation: Fish and chips is a classic from the United Kingdom. Rice and beans and tacos with salsa come from other parts of the world.
quests.funFact: Fish and chips is traditionally served wrapped in paper.

quests.instruction: Which deep-red soup made with beets is popular in Ukraine and other parts of Eastern Europe?
quests.hint: Its color comes from a root vegetable.
quests.explanation: Borscht gets its red color from beets. Pho is Vietnamese and miso soup is Japanese.
quests.funFact: Borscht can be served hot or cold, often with a spoonful of sour cream.

quests.instruction: Which dish from Quebec in Canada tops fries with cheese curds and gravy?
quests.hint: The cheese melts a little under the hot gravy.
quests.explanation: Poutine is a Canadian dish of fries, cheese curds and gravy. Dim sum and pad thai are Asian dishes.
quests.funFact: Fresh cheese curds squeak when you bite into them.

quests.instruction: Which Brazilian stew of black beans is traditionally served with rice?
quests.hint: It simmers slowly for hours.
quests.explanation: Feijoada is Brazil's famous black bean stew. Borscht is made of beets and miso soup uses soybean paste.
quests.funFact: Feijoada is often cooked slowly for a family meal on the weekend.

quests.instruction: Which thick cornmeal porridge, shaped and eaten with the hands, is a staple in Kenya and Tanzania?
quests.hint: It is rolled into a ball and used to scoop stew.
quests.explanation: Ugali is made from cooked cornmeal. An arepa is a corn cake from South America and couscous is a North African wheat food.
quests.funFact: People roll a small ball of ugali with their fingers and use it to scoop up stew.

quests.instruction: At many Ethiopian meals, what do people use to scoop up stew?
quests.hint: The bread is the spoon.
quests.explanation: Pieces of soft injera bread scoop up the stew, so no spoon is needed. Spoons or straws are not used.
quests.funFact: Sharing food from one platter is a way of showing friendship in many cultures.

quests.instruction: In many Middle Eastern meals, pita bread is torn into pieces. What is it used for?
quests.correctAnswer: Scooping up dips and other foods 🫓
options: Scooping up dips and other foods 🫓
quests.hint: Think about how bread can work like a spoon.
quests.explanation: Pita pieces scoop up dips like hummus and other foods. They do not cool dishes or clean plates.
quests.funFact: Pita puffs up in a very hot oven, which creates the pocket inside.

quests.instruction: Many dishes are shared in the middle of the table. What is a polite way to serve yourself?
quests.correctAnswer: Take a little of each dish and pass it on 🍽️
options: Take a little of each dish and pass it on 🍽️
Take all of the best dish for yourself 🏆
Eat from the shared bowl with your own spoon 🥄
quests.hint: Think about everyone at the table.
quests.explanation: Taking a little of each dish and passing it on makes sure everyone gets a turn.
quests.funFact: Sharing dishes is a tradition in many cultures, from Chinese banquets to Ethiopian platters.

quests.instruction: Which pair is a staple grain and a food made from it?
quests.hint: Ask yourself what each food is made from.
quests.explanation: Arepas are made from corn. Baguettes are made from wheat, and sushi is made from rice.
quests.funFact: Many staple foods become different dishes in different places.

quests.instruction: Pho, pad thai and paella are famous dishes. Which one comes from Spain?
quests.hint: One of these three is a rice dish, not a noodle dish.
quests.explanation: Paella is a rice dish from Spain. Pho is from Vietnam and pad thai is from Thailand.
quests.funFact: Paella began in the Valencia region of Spain.

quests.instruction: Which statement about foods from around the world is respectful?
quests.correctAnswer: Every culture has delicious foods to learn about 🌍
options: Foods from faraway places are simply strange 🙄
Only a handful of countries have real cooking 🏆
Every culture has delicious foods to learn about 🌍
quests.hint: Think about how you would like others to talk about your family's food.
quests.explanation: Every culture has foods that are special to the people who make them, and they are worth learning about.
quests.funFact: Learning about other people's foods is a friendly way to learn about their lives.
